_comment: Canonical product catalog (Phase 2.1). Single source consumed by the Leptos dashboard sidebar/Apps Hub AND the marketing site Nav megamenu. Adding a plugin: append to `plugins`, then sidebar + landing megamenu pick it up automatically.

plugins.name: DevGuard
plugins.long_desc: Block secrets, dangerous shell commands, exfil patterns, and unsanctioned tools before the agent runs them. Ships with a default policy and a wizard-driven authoring flow.

plugins.name: TraceTramp
plugins.long_desc: Records the governed execution path: decisions, tool calls, and LLM exchanges. Reconstruct a run on traffic that went through the node.

plugins.name: WitnessCtl
plugins.long_desc: Issues HMAC-chained receipts a reviewer can inspect. Issuer HMAC is evidence, not court-grade custody and not a sold certification.

plugins.name: Conductor
plugins.long_desc: Coordinate fleets of agents with capability handshakes, mesh routing, and consensus. The orchestration layer that turns single agents into teams.

plugins.name: AgentLoop
plugins.long_desc: Per-agent budgets, retries, escalation, and self-healing. The runtime that keeps agents alive without burning the wallet.

plugins.name: LedgerLens
plugins.long_desc: Real-time spend, model attribution, and budget enforcement across agents, tenants, and workflows.

plugins.name: AgentPassport
plugins.long_desc: Planned SKU: portable agent identity. W3C DID packaging is AgentPassport — not a live product today.

plugins.name: Relay
plugins.long_desc: Drop-in HTTP runtime for agents written in any language. No SDK, no framework — just signed requests.

plugins.name: Engram
plugins.long_desc: Planned SKU: tenant-isolated memory with provenance. SOC 2 mapping is a design-partner path, not a sold checkbox.

reference_workflows.name: HITL Approve-and-Audit
reference_workflows.short_desc: Human approval gate with audit emit

reference_workflows.name: PII Redaction Pipeline
reference_workflows.short_desc: Policy scan + LLM rewrite + redaction event
